Name: Management Cost: Planting
Description: Replanting: seedlings and planting, per unit area planted (planted and failed alike)

Name: Management Cost: Site Preparation
Description: Site preparation before replanting (pile and burn, or mechanical), per unit area

Name: Management Cost: Salvage Logging
Description: Salvage logging and haul cost per unit area (its timber revenue is Management Revenue: Salvage Timber)

Name: Management Revenue: Salvage Timber
Description: Revenue from the salvaged timber per unit area, falling with years since the fire (net = revenue - costs)
